reason: The wall-clock is not the binding constraint; the gates and the resource plan are. (1) As written it depends on friend A's 5070 Ti for about 12 h. Friend A has not committed since 24 Sep 04:12 MSK, his PC rebooted, and his queue after #34 is an x138 lab cache first, then H2 dense-proposal (26 Sep morning to 20:00). The idea itself says to start only after H1/H2. That puts its start at 26 Sep >= 20:00 UTC and a score around 28 Sep, P ~0.35 (CONTEXT.md l.1543). (2) A probe exists only if both pre-registered gates pass. The LOEO gate needs >= +0.004 over a control in both directions at matched nodes. The value lens showed that exp11's +0.0027 is a node artefact (matched-node edge J -0.0015), and seed noise is +-0.005 (exp16 vs exp03B), so P(pass) ~0.15. The head step needs 'H1's recipe', which does not exist yet. H1's own gate is judged likely to fail (v_..._coordhead-v2_schedule.json), and both 199-video heads, P and Q, failed the out-of-embryo kill test (out_full_P/Q.log; CONTEXT l.1488). P(head passes on new features) ~0.4. P(scored probe by 29 Sep 10:00) ~0.15 x 0.4 x 0.8 ~= 0.05, far below 0.7. (3) The description does not match the code. local_capture.py hardcodes PRIMARY_SHA 12f6881e (l.56), so it cannot capture on a new primary without a patch. tools/build_probe_kernel.py --base x138 supports only divinsert/leafprune, so a primary+head swap needs new builder code. The PU/round loss is unwritten and can be tested here only on synthetic tensors (no data or GPU), so the first real run is also its debug run. 'Joint' is not new: train_patches.py defaults to --freeze none and --edge-loss-weight 1.0, so exp03B/exp30/exp33 were already joint fine-tunes. (4) Resource conflict. The 199-video recapture was run on Kaggle, not locally (vitaliineibauer/biohub-chcap-* shards, 7.2 GPU-h). The full plan costs ~14.5 of vitalii's 30 GPU-h per week (recapture 7.2 + gate ~5 + final fine-tune, B19 dummy and probe dummy ~2.3). About 21 remaining probe dummy runs also need ~14 GPU-h. (5) One probe swaps primary and head together, so a loss cannot be attributed. Even a clean pass is inside LB noise (0.003) given the value lens's -0.003..+0.002.
fix_if_any: Schedule repair (it does not fix the value problem): (a) Move everything off friend A to Kaggle. The competition data is mounted there, and exp03B/exp11 fine-tunes ran there (27 min train, 60 min with eval). Gate = 2 kernels after the 00:00 UTC reset (vitalii, 2 concurrent). K1: 6bba-only PU + control -> threshold-matched raw eval on the 12 LOEO-44b6 videos. K2: 44b6-only PU + control -> 12 6bba videos. ~2.5 h each. Start both arms from friend_a_exp02_loeo20 (out-of-embryo) as well as from pilkwang, and use >= +0.008 as the gate (value-lens fix). (b) Drop the 199-video recapture and head retrain: keep the public V1284 head on the fine-tuned primary. Instead run a 20-video capture (~1.2 GPU-h, one shard kernel with a --primary option added to build_capture_kernel.py) and require the public head's distance reduction on the new features to be within 1 % of its -10..13 % on pilkwang features. This saves ~6 GPU-h, the H1 dependency and ~4 h of wall-clock, and makes the probe a single-change primary swap. (c) Add --primary/--head-path to build_probe_kernel.py --base x138, with a sha256 print. (d) B19: pick the threshold on the dummy clips, but also report the LOEO node ratio per embryo. If the two embryos' matched thresholds differ by more than 0.01, stop (the node shift changes sign: +3.2 % / +5.6 % / -6.6 %). With (a)-(c), the physical path takes ~20 h and ~9 GPU-h. Treat it as optional: the expected value is still <= 0.
realistic_public_gain: -0.003..+0.002 (central ~-0.001; guess, taken from the value lens: exp33/exp35 = 0 at matched nodes; exp11 matched-node edge J -0.0015; head-recapture risk -0.001..-0.004). Below the 0.003 LB noise, so one probe cannot resolve it
realistic_private_gain: -0.004..+0.002 (guess; the node shift changes sign across embryos, so a threshold matched on the dummy clips does not hold on the private embryos)
critical_path: Best case, Kaggle-only (the repaired path; no friend A). 25 Sep 11:30-15:30 UTC, agent container (code only, no data/GPU): PU-mask and round-target options in experiments/_lib/train_patches.py with synthetic-tensor tests; gate kernel builder (2 directions x {PU, control}, threshold sweep 3 values, official metric on 12 videos; a 44b6->6bba split file is needed next to loeo_train6bba_val44b6.json); --primary for build_capture_kernel.py/local_capture.py (PRIMARY_SHA is hardcoded); --primary/--head-path for build_probe_kernel.py --base x138. Vitalii's session commits. 26 Sep 00:00 UTC: vitalii's quota resets. Realistic push ~07:00 UTC (the user sleeps until ~10:00 MSK): vitalii K1+K2 (2 concurrent, ~2.5 GPU-h each). Results ~09:30. GATE 10:00 UTC; P(pass) ~0.15, and on a fail the idea stops. 10:00-11:00: all-199 PU fine-tune (27 min, 2xT4) -> kernel output as dataset. 11:00-12:00: B19 dummy detection run, new primary vs pilkwang node count on the 4 dummy videos (~40 min). 12:00-16:30: 199-video recapture on the new primary in 6 shards. That is 7.2 GPU-h, 3 waves on vitalii (2 concurrent), or 2 waves if friend A pushes 2 shards on sasyami. Repaired alternative: a 20-video capture, 1.2 GPU-h, 12:00-13:30. 16:30-17:30: Vitalii's machine downloads the captures, trains the head (H1 recipe) and runs the kill test on the new features; P(pass) ~0.4, stop on fail. 17:30-19:00: builder patch + dataset (weights + head) + x138 dummy run (~40 min T4). ~19:30 UTC 26 Sep: submit (user OK; 1 of 5 slots). Scored ~27 Sep 03:00-06:00 UTC (x138-class hidden run ~7.5 h; #31 17:09->00:39). Slack ~52 h. As written (friend A): start >= 26 Sep 20:00 after the x138 lab cache and H2. Gate ~27 Sep 02:00-04:00; final fine-tune + 5.5 h recapture ~27 Sep 12:00-14:00; head, kernel and dummy ~18:00; scored ~28 Sep 02:00-06:00, with every handoff (friend A -> Vitalii -> Kaggle) adding 2-8 h. P(on time) ~0.35. Overall P(scored probe before 29 Sep 10:00) = P(gate) 0.15 x P(head kill test) 0.4 x P(no slip) 0.8 ~= 0.05. Without the gates (execution alone): ~0.65 on Kaggle, ~0.35 on friend A.
